items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: Then I had gone through a thing with Moe Gale, a personal thing

ctx.x: Yes, but down the street, across the street from St. Louis, I stayed at Mrs. Fish's and nothing could go on there. She'd be just like she's in the YMCA, or YW. Then I had gone through a thing with Moe Gale, a personal thing, and Moe Gale interceded for Thelma to go with Eddie Cantor.
When did you leave Basie's band, Jo? How long did you stay there?
